newsitem.title: USA: IBM seen helping U.S. stocks open higher.
newsitem.headline: IBM seen helping U.S. stocks open higher.

text.p: Strength in shares of International Business Machines Corp is expected to help Wall Street stocks move higher at the start of trading Thursday despite a softer bond market.

"It looks like a firm opening," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. IBM will be helpful. It underlines the sustenance that quarterly earnings have been giving this market. They have come in above expectations in general, and that has provided upside to the market."
In pre-open trading, IBM shares climbed to 148 from 142-3/8 at Wednesday's NYSE close.
IBM announced after the close first quarter operating earnings of $2.37 per share, above the First Call consensus estimate of $2.28 per share and the $2.21 posted one year ago.
A series of brokerage upgrades followed the results.
U.S. Treasuries weakened, with the long bond down 1/32 to yield 7.09 percent after weekly jobless claims fell to a lower than forecast 324,000 from the previous week's 332,000.
The Standard & Poor's 500 index futures contract for June was up 2.40 at 782.35.
